annotations.title: Most popular APIs in a category

description: Call this when the user asks what other people use, or wants a safe, proven choice: the 3 APIs in a category with the most paying users in the last 30 days, "Most popular" first. APIs with warnings are held back and named. Category ids: web-search, web-extraction, llm-inference, crypto-prices, onchain-data, enrichment, weather, news, social-media, jobs, ecommerce, maps-places, translation, messaging, travel, stocks, pdf-generation, captcha-solving, sports-data. Free, read-only and quick: it never calls or pays the APIs it describes.

platform.description: Sub-category platform ids, any of, e.g. ["instagram","tiktok"]. See list_categories

rail.description: Paid rails to include, e.g. ["x402"] for pay-per-call only (default both)

recent.description: true = only endpoints checked in the last 7 days
